g.text: Four callers, one account — the firewall decides who reaches it, identity decides what they may do
Entra ID · Storage Blob Data Contributor
SAS issued from a stored access policy
az CLI — close the door first, then hand out identity
az storage account update -n prodskycraftswcsa --default-action Deny
az storage account network-rule add -n prodskycraftswcsa \
az role assignment create --role "Storage Blob Data Contributor" \
